# Windows metafile test fixture

`metafile-objects.wmf` is the 384-byte `wmf-objects.wmf` interoperability
fixture from `ChristopherVR/emf-converter`, used only to verify Yayra's local
PowerPoint WMF/EMF recovery path.

Source: <https://github.com/ChristopherVR/emf-converter/blob/main/src/__fixtures__/gdi/wmf-objects.wmf>
